visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a light blue button-down shirt and a black 'PRESS' lanyard, holds a white bowl of ramen towards the camera. She is standing outdoors in front of a ramen stall with a red banner featuring Japanese characters. The lighting is bright and natural. (2) The scene transitions to the exterior of a large modern building at night. A vibrant neon sign reading 'RAMEN TECH' and 'ATTENTION' glows on the facade. The foreground features an artificial grass area with wooden benches and tables under festive lighting. (3) Inside a brightly lit exhibition hall, the camera shows a large vertical monitor displaying a 3D animation of a street. A bowl of ramen appears to float on a conveyor belt. The woman is seen interacting with the display, holding her smartphone to capture the visual effect. (4) The woman holds a black tablet showing a sophisticated music production interface called 'CHORD.' The screen is filled with digital knobs and waveforms in red and grey. The background shows exhibition posters and studio equipment. (5) The woman wears a white VR headset and moves her hands in front of her as if touching something invisible. A split-screen reveals a green-haired virtual avatar mirroring her interactions in a digital room setting. (6) A digital message board is shown where the woman uses a stylus to draw a cartoon character on a touch-sensitive surface. The drawing is instantly projected onto a large digital wall filled with other messages and icons. (7) Back outside at night, the woman stands in front of the 'RAMEN TECH' building with her arms raised in celebration. Digital fireworks and ramen-themed icons are superimposed over the scene.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a high-energy, fast-tempo electronic pop track featuring a driving 4/4 drum beat. A female narrator speaks with intense enthusiasm and high pitch, delivering rapid Mandarin speech. The vocal quality is crisp and studio-like. (2) A distinctive 'whoosh' sound effect emphasizes a visual transition between the outdoor stall and the building exterior. The music continues without interruption, maintaining a joyful major key. The speech density is high, with almost no pauses. (3) During the indoor exhibition segments, subtle synthesized sound effects like 'pops' and 'pings' are layered over the background music to denote UI interactions. A high-pitched, anime-style female voice briefly interacts with the main narrator during the VTuber scene. (4) The track concludes with a swell in the background music's synthesizer chords. The narrator's voice reaches its peak arousal level, conveying excitement. There is minimal noise interference throughout the entire recording.
